title: Active Surface-Potential Measurement Design for Physics-Informed Reconstruction of Buried Grounding Electrodes: Reproducibility Package
description: Version 1.2.0 extends the archived v1.1.0 package with the additional post-hoc acquisition benchmarks reported in the final manuscript. The update adds an estimator-matched D-optimal benchmark, a 200-layout Random acquisition ensemble with frozen seed range and convergence summaries, and a 956-location full-grid inversion used only as a dense-data reference. These analyses reuse the already-consumed 84-case FEM population and do not constitute a new independent validation set. The original A-optimal method was not retuned using the additional benchmark outcomes. Version 1.2.0 also retains the numerical held-out and noise-stress materials and the scaled MTR-1522 physical proof-of-concept package from v1.1.0, including physical full-grid reconstruction and retrospective N=15 Active-versus-Space replay materials.
